note: Set A captures the general sheet notes that B omits entirely (dotted lines = door swing, layered swing lines = tilt-and-turn operation) and correctly binds the railing post material (powdercoated steel flatbar, typical), the solar envelope 18'-0" and grade level 0'-0" datums, and the 2 x APSE-20 (40 tube) array. Set B invents a binding of PV SOLAR ARRAY to "Roof", gives a vague "presence | installed" claim and a trivial sheet-title claim, garbles the cable-railing value as 1/8" ", and uses a non-verbatim quote ("P1 CEMENT FIBRE BOARD SIDING") plus the mislabelled condition "Detail C1" (C1 is the South Elevation view, not a detail). A's weaknesses are mainly redundancy (handrails and cladding repeated several times) and calling the 18'-0" solar-envelope height an "elevation", while B also misses the door-swing notes and the solar-envelope/grade datums. A is the more faithful and complete set overall.
